steps.note: Sent by the kit once the app has started, from every MapSchedule in Program.cs. It replaces the whole set; an empty list removes them all. 07:00 in Johannesburg is 05:00 UTC.

The scheduler leases due rows and posts to Edge's control listener with the platform's service token. The signature is HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>." + body, keyed with the app's token. Ids and values illustrative.
Edge wakes the app if it sleeps and forwards the body and signature unchanged to the app on its own network. It signs nothing; Edge answers the scheduler with the app's status.
The kit checks the signature and that it is under 5 minutes old, then runs the handler and answers 204. Throwing marks the run failed. The schedule moves to its next time either way.

variations.title: The cron is not five fields

output: Unhandled exception. System.ArgumentException: Schedule 'nightly-digest' has cron 'every day at 7'. Use five fields — minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week — with digits, *, /, ',' and '-' only, e.g. '0 7 * * *'. (Parameter 'cron')
steps.note: Refused where it is written, so the app does not start. A name that is not a lowercase slug is refused the same way.

body.title: The request is not valid
body.detail: 'Mars/Olympus' is not a time zone this platform knows (use an IANA name such as UTC or Europe/London).

steps.note: The kit does not check the time zone; the platform does. Also refused: "An app declares at most 50 schedules." and "Two schedules have the same name."

output: Declaring schedules and webhooks failed (attempt 1); retrying: The platform answered PUT platform/v1/schedules with 400: 'Mars/Olympus' is not a time zone this platform knows (use an IANA name such as UTC or Europe/London).
Endgame app kit: the platform never accepted this app's 1 schedule(s) and 0 webhook(s); they will not run until the app restarts: The platform answered PUT platform/v1/schedules with 400: …
steps.note: The app keeps serving. It retries five times, then gives up until the next start.

variations.title: An unsigned call reaches the app

body.title: Unsigned schedule call
body.detail: Only the platform may run schedules.

steps.note: Missing, wrong, or more than 5 minutes old: the handler never runs. The problem also carries a traceId.
Edge's public side never routes _platform/*; it answers 404 before the app sees anything.

variations.title: The app is paused, or has never started

body.title: The app is Paused; it is not called back.

steps.note: Edge does not wake a paused app for a schedule.

output: Schedule nightly-digest of app 7d0c5a9e-2b41-4f6a-9a51-3c8e2d1f0b77 did not succeed: The app answered 409.
Schedule nightly-digest of app 7d0c5a9e-2b41-4f6a-9a51-3c8e2d1f0b77 did not succeed: The app has no platform token yet (it has not been started).
steps.note: The second line is for an app that has never started. Either way the error is recorded on the schedule and it moves on; missed runs run once, not once per miss.
